name: MAGNA Pharmaceuticals, Inc.
old_description: Stahist T is an antihistamine (Triprolidine) which temporarily relieves symptoms due to the common cold, hay fever, allergic rhinitis, or other upper respiratory allergies including runny nose, sneezing, itching of the nose or throat, itchy or watery eyes. Stahist T is recommended at bedtime to dry secretions, facilitate sleep, & enable patients to wake up refreshed. Tablets are scored to facilitate half-tablet, customized dosing.
about:
MAGNA Pharmaceuticals, Inc. was founded on August 1, 1990, in Louisville, Kentucky, as a family-owned pharmaceutical company. The business remains under family ownership and is led by President and CEO Dr. Warren P. Lesser, who emphasizes accountability as a core value.

The company develops and manufactures a range of pharmaceutical products and dietary supplements, including the antihistamine Stahist T (triprolidine) in scored tablets that allow half-tablet dosing. All products are produced to high quality standards at its Louisville facility, though specific production volumes and equipment details are not publicly disclosed.

MAGNA serves the pharmaceutical, specialty pharma, and healthcare sectors, with particular focus on wound care, ostomy, and continence markets. It holds memberships in the Wound, Ostomy, and Continence Nurses Society and the Specialty Pharma Association, reflecting its engagement with clinical professionals and specialty distributors.

The company’s stated mission is to provide non‑substitutable products and services at reasonable prices with genuine concern for stakeholders. Dr. Lesser has said, “We really want to help people. If all we do is make money, we haven’t done anything with our lives that has real value,” underscoring a patient‑focused philosophy.
